name: ECS-48S
title: Switch Enterprise Campus 48S
summary: 48-port L3 stackable Etherlighting campus switch (32x 2.5G, 16x 10G, 4x 25G, 100G stacking); no PoE.

extra.qsfp28_note: 100G QSFP28 ports are stacking-only; no uplink, no breakout
extra.oob_port: (1) 1 GbE RJ45 OOB management only (not counted)
extra.stacking: up to 4 switches, same port count only; cross-stack LAG up to 8 ports

gotchas: No PoE at all ('S' = stacking) - for powered APs/cameras pick ECS-24-PoE or a Pro HD PoE model.
The 2x 100G QSFP28 ports are stacking-only: not usable as uplinks and no breakout cables.
Stacks only with same-port-count switches (max 4) - can't mix with 24-port ECS units.
Full-depth 4-post rack, 4 hot-swap fans - datacenter/closet noise levels.
best_for: dense multi-gig access layers in enterprise closets
